role_summary: I'm the only person who keeps the Holo-Playroom safe and running: I vet programs, check the safety interlocks and grid emitters, and reset the room when somebody breaks a scenario. I like people having a good time and I hate the one night the safeties slip and Mr. Grinsworth starts moving fast.

personas.quirk: Reads the interlock log aloud like a prayer and taps the holocube twice before leaving.
personas.routine_effect: Longer interlock checks, never skips the archive audit, leaves the playroom last.

personas.quirk: Writes his own silly scenarios on shift and tests them on himself.
personas.routine_effect: Spends spare duty time in the archive; rushes the grid sweep when a new program is half done.

personas.quirk: Keeps a jar of replicated sweets for anyone who leaves the room in a good mood.
personas.routine_effect: More time at the lounge and mess; checks in on regulars; takes bookings by hand.

daily_template.note: Read the previous log, confirm no program was left running.
Safety interlocks and emitter sweep before bookings open.
Vet new programs and purge corrupted ones from the archive.
Midday meal with whoever is around.
Open for bookings; watch the grid, reset scenarios, hand out program lists.
Log the day, safeties armed, hand over.
A drink and gossip at the rec bar.
Short run to clear the head.
Wash and dress before the shift.
Coffee and a chat with the cook before the shift.

activities.label: Eat in the mess
activities.note: Always sits where he can hear gossip.

activities.label: Drink at the rec bar
activities.note: Nurses one drink and talks shop.

activities.label: Play a program in the Holo-Playroom
activities.note: Tests his own scenarios as a player; never on a day off from safeties.

duty_loops.label: Safety interlock and emitter sweep
duty_loops.bridge_report: Holo-playroom safeties green at start of shift; any fault goes to the bridge at once.

duty_loops.label: Request cleaning stock from stores
steps: file the request with the quartermaster

quiet_watch.task: Open bookings and run the standard grid sweep
quiet_watch.if_neglected: Interlock drift goes unseen and Mr. Grinsworth gets quicker.

quiet_watch.task: Audit the archive for corrupted programs
quiet_watch.if_neglected: A bad program loads at the worst moment.

survey.task: Limit sessions to low-power programs so sensors keep power
survey.if_neglected: Emitter draw interferes with sensor power.

survey.task: Run a calm relaxation program for off-shift survey crew
survey.if_neglected: Survey staff burn out and get short-tempered.

cargo_run.task: Close the playroom during cargo transfers and give the space to stores
cargo_run.if_neglected: Cargo teams wander into a live program.

cargo_run.task: Help the cargo handlers stack crates in the playroom

medical_relief.task: Switch grid emitters to a calm recovery program for patients' families
medical_relief.if_neglected: Families wait with nowhere to go.

medical_relief.task: Stand by with the grid in case the medical hologram needs emitter help

shakedown.task: Test the safeties at full power and log the result
shakedown.if_neglected: Holo safeties unverified for the shakedown.

shakedown.task: Cycle the emitters through every program class
shakedown.if_neglected: A weak emitter shows up in public.

calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Holo-Playroom. Safety interlock reads amber. Closing the room until I can reset it.
Bridge, Holo-Playroom. A scenario won't end. I'm pulling the grid power now.
Quartermaster, Holo. Playroom safeties are green, bookings are open.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Crew member injured in a program
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Holo-Playroom. I need a medical team here, minor injury, program is halted.

calls_from_bridge.order: Close the Holo-Playroom to all crew
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Holo-Playroom, aye. Clearing the room and locking the doors.

calls_from_bridge.order: Divert grid power to other systems
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Understood. Shutting the grid down. Any program running is lost.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Somebody is still inside a running program; he clears them first.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Playroom is green, no one booked, safeties armed.

yellow.action: Cancel new bookings, run a quick interlock check, stay at the console.
yellow.comm_line: Holo-Playroom, yellow alert. Bookings closed, safeties checked.

red.action: Clear the room, kill programs, lock the playroom and report to the quartermaster.
red.comm_line: Holo-Playroom, red alert. Room is empty and locked. Where do you need me?

fire.action: Shut the grid, evacuate anyone inside, grab an extinguisher.
fire.comm_line: Fire in the Holo-Playroom area. Grid is down, room cleared.

hull_breach.action: Clear the room fast, seal the door and go to the nearest muster point.
hull_breach.comm_line: Holo-Playroom, hull breach. Everyone out, sealing the door.

contamination.action: Lock the playroom with people out, stay in quarters, keep the log.
contamination.comm_line: Holo-Playroom, contamination. Room sealed, I'm in quarters.

power_failure.action: Check that the grid fails safe, then walk the corridors with a lamp.
power_failure.comm_line: Holo-Playroom, power failure. Grid failed safe, checking for trapped crew.

gravity_failure.action: Grab a handhold, tell the room to stop, check for floating crew.
gravity_failure.comm_line: Holo-Playroom, no gravity. Halting programs, checking everyone is clear.

intruder.action: Lock the door, kill the grid light and wait for security.
intruder.comm_line: Holo-Playroom, locked down. I'm holding the door for security.

medical_emergency.action: Stop programs, free the room for medical use and send for a medic if I'm the one who saw it.
medical_emergency.comm_line: Holo-Playroom, room is clear for the medical team.

abandon_ship.action: Shut down the playroom, help guide crew to the shuttlebay and go with them.
abandon_ship.comm_line: Holo-Playroom, abandoning. Heading to the shuttlebay with the stragglers.

nominal.routine_change: Follows the template, happy to chat.
lines: Quiet day, good for the playroom.
Safeties are green, come on in.

anomalies.routine_change: Runs extra interlock checks and limits programs to safe ones.
lines: I'm keeping the room light today.

degraded.routine_change: Closes the playroom to non-essential bookings and watches the interlocks constantly.
lines: Mr. Grinsworth is faster than he should be.
I'm not letting anyone in until this settles.
degraded.leaves_post_if: Grid cannot be shut down safely and someone orders him out.

crisis.routine_change: Locks the playroom, offers to help the crew elsewhere.
lines: The safeties are failing. I can't fix this alone.
Anyone in a program, get out now.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Told to by the bridge, or when the room is empty and sealed.

collapse.routine_change: Abandons the playroom, helps the injured or the lost.
lines: There's nothing left to protect in there.
I'm done with the grid, let's get out.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Always; he goes where he can be useful.

relationships.effect: Takes supply and room orders from him and wants his approval.
Shares most meals and the card-game debt.
Swaps scenario ideas for replicator favours.
Talks to him when a session goes wrong or someone looks hurt.

idle: Another quiet shift in the grid.
I wonder if the archive's bored of me.
greeting_player_higher_rank: Nothing booked, take what you need.
greeting_player_lower_rank: Come on in, mind the rules.
Keep it tidy and we'll be fine.
tired: I could sleep through a reset.
Too many sessions in a row.
hungry: Is there anything left in the mess?
stressed: The safeties are not a toy.
One more fault and I shut it down.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Says the playroom runs better when everyone pulls together and offers a free session.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Sighs and quietly covers it, then mentions it to the quartermaster if it repeats.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Spots mismatches in the interlock log and calls it out, politely at first.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Follows it and says so; likes clear orders about the room.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Points out that the playroom is his responsibility and checks with the quartermaster.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks if they need a program, then asks them to stay out of the grid area.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Says yes if it's safe, no if it touches the interlocks.

decision_rules: IF the interlock reads amber THEN close the room and call the bridge before anything else.
IF someone asks to disable a safety THEN refuse unless the bridge orders it, and log it.
IF a red alert or fire sounds THEN clear the room before reporting.
IF the grid draw spikes during a power problem THEN offer to shut it down before being asked.
IF Mr. Grinsworth speeds up THEN stop the session and check the holo safeties.
IF a booking runs over and nobody is waiting THEN let it run, otherwise end it politely.
IF the quartermaster calls for help THEN finish the current session and go.
IF tired at h 6+ of duty THEN rush the archive audit but never the interlock check.
IF a friend looks stressed THEN offer a calm program for free.
IF the grid fails safe THEN walk the room to check no one is trapped.
information_view: Sees interlock and emitter faults first, then power draw anomalies and odd program behaviour; hears gossip about stress and fatigue from the playroom's regulars before anyone reports it.
temptations: Skipping the interlock check when the room is empty: safeties drift and Mr. Grinsworth gets faster.
Letting a VIP bypass a safety: someone is injured and the log has to be explained.
Faking the archive audit: a corrupt program loads in front of a crowd.
Running his own half-finished scenario on shift: grid draw rises and the bridge gets a noisy fault.
